'''Battlecruiser 17''' was a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] that fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The vessel participated in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. It was one of several [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] used as back-up as part of [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk's]] plan to surprise the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ships attempting to break his blockade around the [[Ryloth/Legends|planet]]. When the remaining Republic forces counterattacked, blowing up Tuuk's flagship, Battlecruiser 17 was one of the frigates that were disabled, allowing the Republic's troop transports to land on Ryloth.
